requests.rule: Historical-only nonparticipation may be established from a complete relevant category inventory only with resolved player/game identity, independently supported applicable professional team membership, final inventory completeness and no contradictory played record. Missing row alone never qualifies. A nonstarting pitcher may still relieve and is not a DNP.
requests.missingPrerequisites: Exact applicable rosters and category completeness are not yet verified for these targets. Approval would not permit blanket conversion.
requests.risk: Omitted actors or stale professional membership can create false zeros. Keep unresolved when any predicate fails.

requests.rule: For ordinary final2023games only, use the latest supported official local game date plus2UTCcalendar days as a conservative proxy completion day; publish modeled knowledge at00:00UTC two further days later. Weekly sensitivity remains the first Wednesday12:00UTC at/after that floor. Never claim the proxy is observed completion.
sourceFields: Supported date of final completion for exceptions
exclusions: Suspended/resumed/shortened or rain-called games without actual final-call day
requests.risk: No finite lag can repair an undetected multi-day suspension. Reliable exception inventory is mandatory. Delaying ordinary observations fourdays sacrifices information and still is a modeled chronology.
requests.comparison: Verified D1 remains completionUTCday+2. Current diagnostic uses scheduledUTCday+2 and is unaccepted. This candidate usually delays by2or3additional days vs scheduled model; exact comparisons require local-date and exception facts before activation.

requests.rule: Historical goalie credit may be reconstructed only from a final official game summary showing exactly one goalie, full final game time played, winning decision, no goals allowed, no shared/empty-net ambiguity, and an independently explicit shutout credit or reviewed award rule. Zero goals against alone never qualifies.
requests.missingPrerequisites: Fetched official summaries support sole goalie and final zero goals but do not explicitly publish SO credit. Additional credit evidence or narrowly reviewed reconstruction rule required.
requests.risk: Fixed-assignment bounds exclude changes to future model rankings, lineups, waivers and replacement choices.
